en: She is Empress, beloved by Franz Joseph, beloved by the people.
zh: 她是皇后，深受弗朗茨·約瑟夫和人民的愛戴。
ja: 彼女は皇后であり、フランツ・ヨーゼフと国民に愛されています。
local: She is Empress, beloved by Franz Joseph, beloved by the people.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa kōgō de ari, Furantsu Yōzefu to kokumin ni aisarete imasu.
native: She is Empress, beloved by Franz Joseph, beloved by the people.

en: Yet she is not happy. Her children are taken from her. She stoves flees away to Hungary to England.
zh: 然而她並不快樂。她的孩子被奪走。她逃往匈牙利，再到英格蘭。
ja: しかし、彼女は幸せではありません。子供たちは彼女から奪われました。彼女は匈牙利へ、そしてイングランドへ逃げました。
local: Yet she is not happy. Her children are taken from her. She stoves flees away to Hungary to England.
ja_pron: Shikashi, kanojo wa shiawase de wa arimasen. Kodomotachi wa kanojo kara ubawaremashita. Kanojo wa Kyōgari e, soshite Ingurando e nigemashita.
native: Yet she is not happy. Her children are taken from her. She stoves flees away to Hungary to England.

en: She is the triumph and her deepest sorrow.
zh: 她是勝利，也是她最深的悲傷。
ja: 彼女は勝利であり、最も深い悲しみでもあります。
local: She is the triumph and her deepest sorrow.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa shōri de ari, mottomo fukai kanashimi demo arimasu.
native: She is the triumph and her deepest sorrow.

en: Elizabeth became an early mother. At 17, she gave birth to her first child, little Sophie.
zh: 伊麗莎白很早就成為母親。17歲時，她生下了第一個孩子，小索菲。
ja: エリザベートは若くして母親になりました。17歳で最初の子供、小さなソフィーを産みました。
local: Elizabeth became an early mother. At 17, she gave birth to her first child, little Sophie.
ja_pron: Erizabēto wa wakaku shite hahaoya ni narimashita. 17-sai de saisho no kodomo, chiisana Sofī o umimashita.
native: Elizabeth became an early mother. At 17, she gave birth to her first child, little Sophie.

en: Hardly born, Archduches Sophie took the child from her.
zh: 索菲剛出生，大公女索菲就把孩子從她身邊帶走了。
ja: 生まれたばかりの子供を、大公女ソフィーが彼女から奪い取りました。
local: Hardly born, Archduches Sophie took the child from her.
ja_pron: Umareta bakari no kodomo o, taikōjo Sofī ga kanojo kara ubaitorimashita.
native: Hardly born, Archduches Sophie took the child from her.

en: She dictated the clothing and the daily routine.
zh: 她決定了孩子的穿著和日常作息。
ja: 彼女は子供の服装や日課を指示しました。
local: She dictated the clothing and the daily routine.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa kodomo no fukusō ya nikka o shiji shimashita.
native: She dictated the clothing and the daily routine.

en: Elizabeth was only allowed to see her daughter at scheduled times.
zh: 伊麗莎白只能在指定時間見她的女兒。
ja: エリザベートは決められた時間にしか娘に会うことが許されませんでした。
local: Elizabeth was only allowed to see her daughter at scheduled times.
ja_pron: Erizabēto wa kimerareta jikan ni shika musume ni au koto ga yurusaremasen deshita.
native: Elizabeth was only allowed to see her daughter at scheduled times.

en: In 1857, the 20-year-old Sissy accompanied her husband on a trip to Hungary.
zh: 1857年，20歲的西西陪同丈夫前往匈牙利旅行。
ja: 1857年、20歳のシシィは夫と共にハンガリーへ旅に出ました。
local: In 1857, the 20-year-old Sissy accompanied her husband on a trip to Hungary.
ja_pron: 1857-nen, 20-sai no Shishii wa otto to tomo ni Hangarī e tabi ni demashita.
native: In 1857, the 20-year-old Sissy accompanied her husband on a trip to Hungary.

en: Against Dr.'s advice, she takes two-year-old Sophie with her, who falls gravely ill and dies at just two years old.
zh: 違背醫生的建議，她帶著兩歲的索菲同行，索菲病重並在兩歲時去世。
ja: 医師の助言に反して、彼女は2歳のソフィーを連れて行きましたが、ソフィーは重病にかかり、2歳で亡くなりました。
local: Against Dr.'s advice, she takes two-year-old Sophie with her, who falls gravely ill and dies at just two years old.
ja_pron: Ishi no jogen ni hanshite, kanojo wa 2-sai no Sofī o tsurete ikimashita ga, Sofī wa jūbyō ni kakari, 2-sai de nakunarimashita.
native: Against Dr.'s advice, she takes two-year-old Sophie with her, who falls gravely ill and dies at just two years old.

en: For Elizabeth, it's a shock. The public holds her responsible. They claim she subjected the child to the hardships.
zh: 對伊麗莎白來說，這是個震驚。公眾責怪她，認為她讓孩子遭受苦難。
ja: エリザベートにとって、それは衝撃でした。世間は彼女を責め、子供に苦難を与えたと非難しました。
local: For Elizabeth, it's a shock. The public holds her responsible. They claim she subjected the child to the hardships.
ja_pron: Erizabēto ni totte, sore wa shōgeki deshita. Seken wa kanojo o seme, kodomo ni kunan o ataeta to hinan shimashita.
native: For Elizabeth, it's a shock. The public holds her responsible. They claim she subjected the child to the hardships.

en: Sissy falls into depression. I can't take it anymore.
zh: 西西陷入憂鬱。我再也受不了了。
ja: シシィはうつ状態に陥りました。もう耐えられません。
local: Sissy falls into depression. I can't take it anymore.
ja_pron: Shishii wa utsu jōtai ni ochiirimashita. Mō taeraremasen.
native: Sissy falls into depression. I can't take it anymore.

en: She withdraws, leaving the upbringing of the other children entirely to her mother-in-law.
zh: 她退縮了，將其他孩子的撫養完全交給了她的婆婆。
ja: 彼女は引きこもり、他の子供たちの育児を完全に姑に任せました。
local: She withdraws, leaving the upbringing of the other children entirely to her mother-in-law.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa hikikomori, hoka no kodomotachi no ikuji o kanzen ni shūto ni makasemashita.
native: She withdraws, leaving the upbringing of the other children entirely to her mother-in-law.

en: A year after Sophie, Gisela is born, a well-behaved, conforming child, diligent, obedient, conventional.
zh: 索菲去世一年後，吉賽拉出生，她是個乖巧、守規矩、勤奮、聽話、傳統的孩子。
ja: ソフィーの1年後にギーゼラが生まれました。彼女はおとなしく、従順で、勤勉で、伝統的な子供でした。
local: A year after Sophie, Gisela is born, a well-behaved, conforming child, diligent, obedient, conventional.
ja_pron: Sofī no 1-nen go ni Gīzera ga umaremashita. Kanojo wa otonashiku, jūjun de, kinben de, dentō-teki na kodomo deshita.
native: A year after Sophie, Gisela is born, a well-behaved, conforming child, diligent, obedient, conventional.

en: The opposite of her mother, there is never any closeness between them.
zh: 她與母親完全相反，兩人之間從未有過親密關係。
ja: 彼女は母親とは正反対で、二人の間に親密さはありませんでした。
local: The opposite of her mother, there is never any closeness between them.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa hahaoya to wa seihantai de, futari no aida ni shinmitsusa wa arimasen deshita.
native: The opposite of her mother, there is never any closeness between them.

en: In 1858, the longed four-air Rudolph is born.
zh: 1858年，期待已久的第四個孩子魯道夫出生了。
ja: 1858年、待望の四男ルドルフが生まれました。
local: In 1858, the longed four-air Rudolph is born.
ja_pron: 1858-nen, taibō no yonnan Rudorufu ga umaremashita.
native: In 1858, the longed four-air Rudolph is born.

en: Elizabeth is 20 years old, but he also becomes estranged from her.
zh: 伊麗莎白20歲，但他也與她疏遠了。
ja: エリザベートは20歳ですが、彼も彼女から疎遠になりました。
local: Elizabeth is 20 years old, but he also becomes estranged from her.
ja_pron: Erizabēto wa 20-sai desu ga, kare mo kanojo kara soen ni narimashita.
native: Elizabeth is 20 years old, but he also becomes estranged from her.

en: At the age of five, he is handed over to a harsh tutor.
zh: 五歲時，他被交給了一位嚴厲的家庭教師。
ja: 5歳の時、彼は厳しい家庭教師に預けられました。
local: At the age of five, he is handed over to a harsh tutor.
ja_pron: 5-sai no toki, kare wa kibishii katei kyōshi ni azukeraremashita.
native: At the age of five, he is handed over to a harsh tutor.

en: The training is in human, wake up calls with gunshots, marches in the cold, intimidation.
zh: 訓練非常嚴苛，有槍聲叫醒、寒冷中行軍、恐嚇等。
ja: 訓練は過酷で、銃声で起こされ、寒さの中で行進し、威嚇されました。
local: The training is in human, wake up calls with gunshots, marches in the cold, intimidation.
ja_pron: Kunren wa kakoku de, jūsei de okosare, samusa no naka de kōshin shi, ikaku saremashita.
native: The training is in human, wake up calls with gunshots, marches in the cold, intimidation.

en: Rudolph almost breaks under it.
zh: 魯道夫幾乎被折磨垮了。
ja: ルドルフはそれにほとんど耐えられませんでした。
local: Rudolph almost breaks under it.
ja_pron: Rudorufu wa sore ni hotondo taeraremasen deshita.
native: Rudolph almost breaks under it.

en: That's when 23-year-old Elizabeth steps in for the first time.
zh: 這時，23歲的伊麗莎白首次介入。
ja: その時、23歳のエリザベートが初めて介入しました。
local: That's when 23-year-old Elizabeth steps in for the first time.
ja_pron: Sono toki, 23-sai no Erizabēto ga hajimete kainyū shimashita.
native: That's when 23-year-old Elizabeth steps in for the first time.

en: She presents Franz Joseph with an ultimatum, either the tutor leaves or I will.
zh: 她向弗朗茨·約瑟夫提出最後通牒，要麼家庭教師離開，要麼她離開。
ja: 彼女はフランツ・ヨーゼフに最後通告を出しました。家庭教師が去るか、私が去るかどちらかです。
local: She presents Franz Joseph with an ultimatum, either the tutor leaves or I will.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa Furantsu Yōzefu ni saigo tsūkoku o dashimashita. Kateikyōshi ga saru ka, watashi ga saru ka dochira ka desu.
native: She presents Franz Joseph with an ultimatum, either the tutor leaves or I will.

en: An unheard of move for an Empress, but the Emperor gives in, Rudolph gets a gentler teacher.
zh: 這對皇后來說是前所未聞的舉動，但皇帝讓步了，魯道夫得到了更溫和的老師。
ja: 皇后としては前代未聞の行動でしたが、皇帝は折れ、ルドルフにはより優しい教師がつきました。
local: An unheard of move for an Empress, but the Emperor gives in, Rudolph gets a gentler teacher.
ja_pron: Kōgō to shite wa zendaimimon no kōdō deshita ga, kōtei wa ore, Rudorufu ni wa yori yasashii kyōshi ga tsukimashita.
native: An unheard of move for an Empress, but the Emperor gives in, Rudolph gets a gentler teacher.

en: Sissy has achieved her first victory.
zh: 西西取得了她的第一次勝利。
ja: シシィは最初の勝利を手に入れました。
local: Sissy has achieved her first victory.
ja_pron: Shishii wa saisho no shōri o te ni iremashita.
native: Sissy has achieved her first victory.

en: Yet deep inside, she remains torn apart. The defeats as a mother have left lasting scars.
zh: 然而在內心深處，她依然支離破碎。作為母親的失敗留下了持久的傷痕。
ja: しかし内心では、彼女は引き裂かれたままです。母親としての敗北は深い傷を残しました。
local: Yet deep inside, she remains torn apart. The defeats as a mother have left lasting scars.
ja_pron: Shikashi naishin de wa, kanojo wa hikisakareta mama desu. Hahaoya to shite no haiboku wa fukai kizu o nokoshimashita.
native: Yet deep inside, she remains torn apart. The defeats as a mother have left lasting scars.

en: Elizabeth crafts her own weapons. She stoves, tightens her corset painfully, achieving a wasp waste that shocks all.
zh: 伊麗莎白打造自己的武器。她節食，痛苦地束緊緊身胸衣，達到令人震驚的細腰。
ja: エリザベートは自分の武器を作り出しました。彼女は食事制限をし、痛みを伴いながらコルセットを締め、みんなを驚かせる細いウエストを手に入れました。
local: Elizabeth crafts her own weapons. She stoves, tightens her corset painfully, achieving a wasp waste that shocks all.
ja_pron: Erizabēto wa jibun no buki o tsukuridashimashita. Kanojo wa shokujiseigen o shi, itami o tomonai nagara korusetto o shime, minna o odorokaseru hosoi uesuto o te ni iremashita.
native: Elizabeth crafts her own weapons. She stoves, tightens her corset painfully, achieving a wasp waste that shocks all.

en: She exercises like a maniac, rides, marches, drives, carriages, even smokes.
zh: 她像瘋子一樣鍛鍊，騎馬、行軍、駕駛馬車，甚至抽煙。
ja: 彼女は狂ったように運動し、乗馬し、行進し、馬車を操り、さらには喫煙もしました。
local: She exercises like a maniac, rides, marches, drives, carriages, even smokes.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa kurutta yō ni undō shi, jōba shi, kōshin shi, basha o ayatsuri, sarani wa kitsuen mo shimashita.
native: She exercises like a maniac, rides, marches, drives, carriages, even smokes.

en: Her body turns into a battlefield and protest, but it collapses, fever, cough, exhaustion.
zh: 她的身體成為戰場和抗議，但最終崩潰，發燒、咳嗽、疲憊。
ja: 彼女の体は戦場であり抗議の場となりましたが、やがて崩れ、熱、咳、疲労に襲われました。
local: Her body turns into a battlefield and protest, but it collapses, fever, cough, exhaustion.
ja_pron: Kanojo no karada wa senjō de ari kōgi no ba to narimashita ga, yagate kuzure, netsu, seki, hirō ni osowaremashita.
native: Her body turns into a battlefield and protest, but it collapses, fever, cough, exhaustion.

en: I can't take it anymore. Majesty, you must rest.
zh: 我受不了了。陛下，您必須休息。
ja: もう耐えられません。陛下、休まなければなりません。
local: I can't take it anymore. Majesty, you must rest.
ja_pron: Mō taeraremasen. Heika, yasumanakereba narimasen.
native: I can't take it anymore. Majesty, you must rest.

en: The doctors sent her to Madeira and Venice. She is recovering, but she will never be healthy again.
zh: 醫生送她去馬德拉和威尼斯。她正在康復，但她再也無法恢復健康。
ja: 医師たちは彼女をマデイラとヴェネツィアに送りました。彼女は回復していますが、二度と健康には戻れません。
local: The doctors sent her to Madeira and Venice. She is recovering, but she will never be healthy again.
ja_pron: Ishitachi wa kanojo o Madeira to Venetsia ni okurimashita. Kanojo wa kaifuku shite imasu ga, nido to kenkō ni wa modoremasen.
native: The doctors sent her to Madeira and Venice. She is recovering, but she will never be healthy again.

en: These journeys, however, open up a new world for her, the escape.
zh: 然而，這些旅程為她開啟了新世界，成為她的逃避之地。
ja: しかしこれらの旅は彼女に新しい世界、逃避の場を開きました。
local: These journeys, however, open up a new world for her, the escape.
ja_pron: Shikashi korera no tabi wa kanojo ni atarashii sekai, tōhi no ba o hirakimashita.
native: These journeys, however, open up a new world for her, the escape.

en: Travel becomes her outlet, her method of breaking free from the confines of the prison.
zh: 旅行成為她的出口，是她擺脫監獄束縛的方法。
ja: 旅は彼女の逃げ場となり、牢獄の束縛から解放される手段となりました。
local: Travel becomes her outlet, her method of breaking free from the confines of the prison.
ja_pron: Tabi wa kanojo no nigeba to nari, rōgoku no sokubaku kara kaihō sareru shudan to narimashita.
native: Travel becomes her outlet, her method of breaking free from the confines of the prison.

en: As early as 1857, the 20-year-old Elizabeth had fallen in love with Hungary,
zh: 早在1857年，20歲的伊麗莎白就愛上了匈牙利，
ja: 早くも1857年に、20歳のエリザベートはハンガリーに恋をしていました。
local: As early as 1857, the 20-year-old Elizabeth had fallen in love with Hungary,
ja_pron: Hayakumo 1857-nen ni, 20-sai no Erizabēto wa Hangarī ni koi o shite imashita.
native: As early as 1857, the 20-year-old Elizabeth had fallen in love with Hungary,

en: a country that is different from Vienna, wild, proud, full of life.
zh: 一個與維也納不同的國家，野性、驕傲、充滿生命力。
ja: ウィーンとは異なる国で、野性的で誇り高く、生き生きとしています。
local: a country that is different from Vienna, wild, proud, full of life.
ja_pron: Uīn to wa kotonaru kuni de, yasei-teki de hokori takaku, ikiiki to shite imasu.
native: a country that is different from Vienna, wild, proud, full of life.

en: She adores the dances, the music, and the freedom, and the people adore her.
zh: 她熱愛舞蹈、音樂和自由，人民也愛戴她。
ja: 彼女は踊りや音楽、自由を愛し、人々も彼女を愛しました。
local: She adores the dances, the music, and the freedom, and the people adore her.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa odori ya ongaku, jiyū o aishi, hitobito mo kanojo o aishimashita.
native: She adores the dances, the music, and the freedom, and the people adore her.

en: 1862, Elizabeth is 25 and surprises the court.
zh: 1862年，伊麗莎白25歲，令宮廷驚訝。
ja: 1862年、エリザベートは25歳で宮廷を驚かせました。
local: 1862, Elizabeth is 25 and surprises the court.
ja_pron: 1862-nen, Erizabēto wa 25-sai de kyūtei o odorokasemashita.
native: 1862, Elizabeth is 25 and surprises the court.

en: She wants to learn Hungarian. Her teacher, Eda von Ferrense, becomes her confidante.
zh: 她想學匈牙利語。她的老師埃達·馮·費倫斯成為她的知己。
ja: 彼女はハンガリー語を学びたいと思い、教師のエダ・フォン・フェレンスは彼女の信頼できる友人になりました。
local: She wants to learn Hungarian. Her teacher, Eda von Ferrense, becomes her confidante.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa Hangarī-go o manabitai to omoi, kyōshi no Eda Fon Ferensu wa kanojo no shinrai dekiru yūjin ni narimashita.
native: She wants to learn Hungarian. Her teacher, Eda von Ferrense, becomes her confidante.

en: They practice for hours, often during hairstyling. No one understands what she's saying.
zh: 她們練習數小時，常在做頭髮時進行。沒有人懂她在說什麼。
ja: 彼女たちは何時間も練習し、よく髪を整えている間に行いました。誰も彼女の言っていることを理解しませんでした。
local: They practice for hours, often during hairstyling. No one understands what she's saying.
ja_pron: Kanojotachi wa nanjikan mo renshū shi, yoku kami o totonoete iru aida ni okonaimashita. Dare mo kanojo no itte iru koto o rikai shimasen deshita.
native: They practice for hours, often during hairstyling. No one understands what she's saying.

en: Hungarian becomes her secret language.
zh: 匈牙利語成為她的秘密語言。
ja: ハンガリー語は彼女の秘密の言葉になりました。
local: Hungarian becomes her secret language.
ja_pron: Hangarī-go wa kanojo no himitsu no kotoba ni narimashita.
native: Hungarian becomes her secret language.

en: Through Eda, she also reaches the ideas of the liberals.
zh: 透過埃達，她也接觸到了自由派的思想。
ja: エダを通じて、彼女は自由主義者の考えにも触れました。
local: Through Eda, she also reaches the ideas of the liberals.
ja_pron: Eda o tsūjite, kanojo wa jiyū shugi-sha no kangae ni mo furemashita.
native: Through Eda, she also reaches the ideas of the liberals.

en: Count Andrasi, names that are considered dangerous in Vienna.
zh: 安德拉西伯爵，這些名字在維也納被視為危險。
ja: アンドラーシ伯爵、その名前はウィーンでは危険視されていました。
local: Count Andrasi, names that are considered dangerous in Vienna.
ja_pron: Andorāshi hakushaku, sono namae wa Uīn de wa kiken-shi sarete imashita.
native: Count Andrasi, names that are considered dangerous in Vienna.

en: For Elizabeth, it's more than just politics.
zh: 對伊麗莎白來說，這不僅僅是政治。
ja: エリザベートにとって、それは単なる政治以上のものでした。
local: For Elizabeth, it's more than just politics.
ja_pron: Erizabēto ni totte, sore wa tan'na seiji ijō no mono deshita.
native: For Elizabeth, it's more than just politics.

en: Hungary will become her second home. Here, she finds what Vienna denies her. Recognition and love.
zh: 匈牙利將成為她的第二個家。在這裡，她找到了維也納拒絕給予她的東西：認可和愛。
ja: ハンガリーは彼女の第二の故郷となります。ここで彼女はウィーンが拒んだもの、認められ愛されることを見つけました。
local: Hungary will become her second home. Here, she finds what Vienna denies her. Recognition and love.
ja_pron: Hangarī wa kanojo no daini no kokyō to narimasu. Koko de kanojo wa Uīn ga kobanda mono, mitomerare aisareru koto o mitsukemashita.
native: Hungary will become her second home. Here, she finds what Vienna denies her. Recognition and love.

en: Then comes the pivotal year of 1866.
zh: 接著是關鍵的1866年。
ja: そして1866年という重要な年が訪れます。
local: Then comes the pivotal year of 1866.
ja_pron: Soshite 1866-nen to iu jūyō na toshi ga otozuremasu.
native: Then comes the pivotal year of 1866.

en: Elizabeth is 29 years old. Austria wages war against Prussia and Italy.
zh: 伊麗莎白29歲。奧地利對普魯士和義大利發動戰爭。
ja: エリザベートは29歳。オーストリアはプロイセンとイタリアに戦争を仕掛けました。
local: Elizabeth is 29 years old. Austria wages war against Prussia and Italy.
ja_pron: Erizabēto wa 29-sai. Ōsutoria wa Puroisen to Itaria ni sensō o shikakemashita.
native: Elizabeth is 29 years old. Austria wages war against Prussia and Italy.

en: At Coney Gratz, the empire suffers a catastrophic defeat.
zh: 在科尼格拉茨，帝國遭受災難性的失敗。
ja: コーニーグラーツで帝国は壊滅的な敗北を喫しました。
local: At Coney Gratz, the empire suffers a catastrophic defeat.
ja_pron: Kōnī Gurātsu de teikoku wa kaimetsuteki na haiboku o kikimashita.
native: At Coney Gratz, the empire suffers a catastrophic defeat.

en: The monarchy teeters perilously on the edge of the abyss.
zh: 君主制岌岌可危，瀕臨深淵邊緣。
ja: 君主制は危険なほど崖っぷちに立たされています。
local: The monarchy teeters perilously on the edge of the abyss.
ja_pron: Kunshusei wa kiken na hodo gakeppuchi ni tatasarete imasu.
native: The monarchy teeters perilously on the edge of the abyss.

en: Elizabeth flees to Hungary with the children, a political stroke of luck, as her presence calms the country.
zh: 伊麗莎白帶著孩子逃往匈牙利，這是政治上的幸運，因為她的存在安撫了國家。
ja: エリザベートは子供たちと共にハンガリーへ逃げました。彼女の存在が国を落ち着かせたため、政治的な幸運でした。
local: Elizabeth flees to Hungary with the children, a political stroke of luck, as her presence calms the country.
ja_pron: Erizabēto wa kodomotachi to tomo ni Hangarī e nigemashita. Kanojo no sonzai ga kuni o ochitsukase ta tame, seijiteki na kōun deshita.
native: Elizabeth flees to Hungary with the children, a political stroke of luck, as her presence calms the country.

en: The Hungarians deeply admire her and heed her words.
zh: 匈牙利人深深敬佩她，並聽從她的話。
ja: ハンガリー人は彼女を深く敬愛し、彼女の言葉に耳を傾けました。
local: The Hungarians deeply admire her and heed her words.
ja_pron: Hangarījin wa kanojo o fukaku keiai shi, kanojo no kotoba ni mimi o katamukemashita.
native: The Hungarians deeply admire her and heed her words.

en: In Budapest, Count Andrasi successfully gains her influence.
zh: 在布達佩斯，安德拉西伯爵成功獲得了她的影響力。
ja: ブダペストでアンドラーシ伯爵は彼女の影響力を得ることに成功しました。
local: In Budapest, Count Andrasi successfully gains her influence.
ja_pron: Budapesuto de Andorāshi hakushaku wa kanojo no eikyōryoku o eru koto ni seikō shimashita.
native: In Budapest, Count Andrasi successfully gains her influence.

en: He persuades her that only a compromise with Hungary can save the monarchy.
zh: 他說服她，只有與匈牙利妥協才能拯救君主制。
ja: 彼は彼女に、ハンガリーとの妥協だけが君主制を救えると説得しました。
local: He persuades her that only a compromise with Hungary can save the monarchy.
ja_pron: Kare wa kanojo ni, Hangarī to no dakyō dake ga kunshusei o sukueru to settoku shimashita.
native: He persuades her that only a compromise with Hungary can save the monarchy.

en: CC urges Franz Joseph finally make peace now.
zh: CC敦促弗朗茨·約瑟夫現在終於達成和平。
ja: CCはフランツ・ヨーゼフに今こそ和平を結ぶよう促しました。
local: CC urges Franz Joseph finally make peace now.
ja_pron: CC wa Furantsu Yōzefu ni ima koso wahei o musubu yō unagashimashita.
native: CC urges Franz Joseph finally make peace now.

en: But the emperor hesitates, since 1848 he has ruled authoritatively.
zh: 但皇帝猶豫不決，自1848年以來他一直以權威統治。
ja: しかし皇帝はためらいました。1848年以来、彼は権威的に統治してきました。
local: But the emperor hesitates, since 1848 he has ruled authoritatively.
ja_pron: Shikashi kōtei wa tamerai mashita. 1848-nen irai, kare wa ken'iteki ni tōchi shite kimashita.
native: But the emperor hesitates, since 1848 he has ruled authoritatively.

en: He fears being bound by a coronation.
zh: 他害怕被加冕儀式束縛。
ja: 彼は戴冠式に縛られることを恐れています。
local: He fears being bound by a coronation.
ja_pron: Kare wa taikanshiki ni shibarareru koto o osorete imasu.
native: He fears being bound by a coronation.

en: To a people, to a constitution, he has no other choice left.
zh: 對人民，對憲法，他別無選擇。
ja: 国民や憲法に対して、彼には他の選択肢が残されていません。
local: To a people, to a constitution, he has no other choice left.
ja_pron: Kokumin ya kenpō ni taishite, kare ni wa hoka no sentakushi ga nokosarete imasen.
native: To a people, to a constitution, he has no other choice left.

en: The defeat was far too devastating.
zh: 這次失敗太過慘重。
ja: 敗北はあまりにも壊滅的でした。
local: The defeat was far too devastating.
ja_pron: Haiboku wa amari ni mo kaimetsuteki deshita.
native: The defeat was far too devastating.

en: Venice is lost and Prussia will ascend to become the new dominant force in Germany.
zh: 威尼斯失守，普魯士將崛起成為德國新的主導力量。
ja: ヴェネツィアは失われ、プロイセンがドイツの新たな支配勢力として台頭します。
local: Venice is lost and Prussia will ascend to become the new dominant force in Germany.
ja_pron: Venetsia wa ushinaware, Puroisen ga Doitsu no aratana shihaiseiryoku to shite taitō shimasu.
native: Venice is lost and Prussia will ascend to become the new dominant force in Germany.

en: Your Majesty, we have no other choice than so be it. This is a twist in the plan.
zh: 陛下，我們別無選擇，只能如此。這是計劃的轉折。
ja: 陛下、他に選択肢はありません。これが計画の転機です。
local: Your Majesty, we have no other choice than so be it. This is a twist in the plan.
ja_pron: Heika, hoka ni sentakushi wa arimasen. Kore ga keikaku no tenki desu.
native: Your Majesty, we have no other choice than so be it. This is a twist in the plan.

en: One year later, the unexpected happens. Franz Joseph agrees.
zh: 一年後，意想不到的事情發生了。弗朗茨·約瑟夫同意了。
ja: 1年後、予期せぬことが起こりました。フランツ・ヨーゼフが同意しました。
local: One year later, the unexpected happens. Franz Joseph agrees.
ja_pron: 1-nen go, yoki senu koto ga okorimashita. Furantsu Yōzefu ga dōi shimashita.
native: One year later, the unexpected happens. Franz Joseph agrees.

en: In June 1867, they parade through Budapest in the Golden Coronation carriage.
zh: 1867年6月，他們乘坐金色加冕馬車遊行布達佩斯。
ja: 1867年6月、彼らは黄金の戴冠馬車でブダペストをパレードしました。
local: In June 1867, they parade through Budapest in the Golden Coronation carriage.
ja_pron: 1867-nen 6-gatsu, karera wa ōgon no taikan basha de Budapesuto o parēdo shimashita.
native: In June 1867, they parade through Budapest in the Golden Coronation carriage.

en: Elizabeth is 30 years old and in her prime.
zh: 伊麗莎白30歲，正值壯年。
ja: エリザベートは30歳で、最盛期にあります。
local: Elizabeth is 30 years old and in her prime.
ja_pron: Erizabēto wa 30-sai de, saiseiki ni arimasu.
native: Elizabeth is 30 years old and in her prime.

en: She is wearing a magnificent dress in the Hungarian style.
zh: 她穿著華麗的匈牙利風格禮服。
ja: 彼女は華麗なハンガリー風のドレスを着ています。
local: She is wearing a magnificent dress in the Hungarian style.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa karei na Hangarī-fū no doresu o kite imasu.
native: She is wearing a magnificent dress in the Hungarian style.

en: Cheer erupts, the crowd celebrates their beloved queen.
zh: 歡呼聲爆發，人群慶祝他們心愛的女王。
ja: 歓声が上がり、群衆は愛される女王を祝いました。
local: Cheer erupts, the crowd celebrates their beloved queen.
ja_pron: Kansei ga agari, gunshū wa aisareru joō o iwaimashita.
native: Cheer erupts, the crowd celebrates their beloved queen.

en: This is her triumph, Sissy's political peak and her second home.
zh: 這是她的勝利，西西的政治巔峰和她的第二個家。
ja: これは彼女の勝利であり、シシィの政治的な絶頂であり、彼女の第二の故郷です。
local: This is her triumph, Sissy's political peak and her second home.
ja_pron: Kore wa kanojo no shōri de ari, Shishii no seijiteki na zecchō de ari, kanojo no daini no kokyō desu.
native: This is her triumph, Sissy's political peak and her second home.

en: In gratitude, the Hungarians gift her Godolo castle, a paradise full of horses, forests and hunts.
zh: 作為感謝，匈牙利人送給她戈多洛城堡，一個充滿馬匹、森林和狩獵的天堂。
ja: 感謝の意を込めて、ハンガリー人は彼女に馬や森、狩猟に満ちたゴドロ城を贈りました。
local: In gratitude, the Hungarians gift her Godolo castle, a paradise full of horses, forests and hunts.
ja_pron: Kansha no i o komete, Hangarījin wa kanojo ni uma ya mori, shuryō ni michita Godoro-jō o okurimashita.
native: In gratitude, the Hungarians gift her Godolo castle, a paradise full of horses, forests and hunts.

en: In 1868, her youngest daughter, Marie Valerie, is born there, known as the Hungarian child.
zh: 1868年，她最小的女兒瑪麗·瓦萊麗出生於此，被稱為匈牙利的孩子。
ja: 1868年、彼女の末娘マリー・ヴァレリーがそこで生まれ、ハンガリーの子供として知られています。
local: In 1868, her youngest daughter, Marie Valerie, is born there, known as the Hungarian child.
ja_pron: 1868-nen, kanojo no suetsumago Marī Varerī ga soko de umare, Hangarī no kodomo to shite shirarete imasu.
native: In 1868, her youngest daughter, Marie Valerie, is born there, known as the Hungarian child.

en: This time, Elizabeth is allowed to decide about the upbringing and her life,
zh: 這一次，伊麗莎白被允許決定孩子的撫養和她的生活，
ja: 今回はエリザベートが子育てや自分の生活について決定することが許されました。
local: This time, Elizabeth is allowed to decide about the upbringing and her life,
ja_pron: Konkai wa Erizabēto ga kosodate ya jibun no seikatsu ni tsuite kettei suru koto ga yurusaremashita.
native: This time, Elizabeth is allowed to decide about the upbringing and her life,

en: at last a child truly belongs to her.
zh: 終於有一個孩子真正屬於她。
ja: ついに子供が本当に彼女のものとなりました。
local: at last a child truly belongs to her.
ja_pron: Tsuini kodomo ga hontō ni kanojo no mono to narimashita.
native: at last a child truly belongs to her.

en: Yet this victory is not without its shadows.
zh: 然而這勝利並非沒有陰影。
ja: しかし、この勝利には影もあります。
local: Yet this victory is not without its shadows.
ja_pron: Shikashi, kono shōri ni wa kage mo arimasu.
native: Yet this victory is not without its shadows.

en: The closeness to Valerie only intensifies the estrangement from Gisela and Rudolph.
zh: 與瓦萊麗的親密只加劇了與吉賽拉和魯道夫的疏遠。
ja: ヴァレリーとの親密さは、ギーゼラとルドルフとの疎遠をさらに強めました。
local: The closeness to Valerie only intensifies the estrangement from Gisela and Rudolph.
ja_pron: Varerī to no shinmitsusa wa, Gīzera to Rudorufu to no soen o sara ni tsuyomemashita.
native: The closeness to Valerie only intensifies the estrangement from Gisela and Rudolph.

en: From childhood, Elizabeth adored horseback riding, a passion she shared with Franz Joseph.
zh: 從小，伊麗莎白熱愛騎馬，這是她與弗朗茨·約瑟夫共同的熱情。
ja: 子供の頃からエリザベートは乗馬を愛しており、それはフランツ・ヨーゼフと共有する情熱でした。
local: From childhood, Elizabeth adored horseback riding, a passion she shared with Franz Joseph.
ja_pron: Kodomo no koro kara Erizabēto wa jōba o aishite ori, sore wa Furantsu Yōzefu to kyōyū suru jōnetsu deshita.
native: From childhood, Elizabeth adored horseback riding, a passion she shared with Franz Joseph.

en: In Vienna's Prussia, her rides become a sensation, drawing eager crowds.
zh: 在維也納的普魯士，她的騎乘成為轟動，吸引了熱情的人群。
ja: ウィーンのプロイセンでは、彼女の乗馬は話題となり、多くの人々を惹きつけました。
local: In Vienna's Prussia, her rides become a sensation, drawing eager crowds.
ja_pron: Uīn no Puroisen de wa, kanojo no jōba wa wadai to nari, ōku no hitobito o hikitsukemashita.
native: In Vienna's Prussia, her rides become a sensation, drawing eager crowds.

en: Everything is perfectly matched, dress, hat, horse, a performance like theatre.
zh: 一切完美搭配，服裝、帽子、馬匹，像戲劇般的表演。
ja: すべてが完璧に調和しており、ドレス、帽子、馬、まるで劇場のようなパフォーマンスでした。
local: Everything is perfectly matched, dress, hat, horse, a performance like theatre.
ja_pron: Subete ga kanpeki ni chōwa shite ori, doresu, bōshi, uma, marude gekijō no yō na pafōmansu deshita.
native: Everything is perfectly matched, dress, hat, horse, a performance like theatre.

en: After the coronation, Godolo becomes her riding haven.
zh: 加冕後，戈多洛成為她的騎馬天堂。
ja: 戴冠式の後、ゴドロは彼女の乗馬の聖地となりました。
local: After the coronation, Godolo becomes her riding haven.
ja_pron: Taikanshiki no ato, Godoro wa kanojo no jōba no seichi to narimashita.
native: After the coronation, Godolo becomes her riding haven.

en: She trains with circus riders, leaps through hoops, gallops cross country, often as the only woman admired for her boldness.
zh: 她與馬戲團騎手訓練，跳過圈圈，越野奔馳，常常是唯一因勇敢而受人欽佩的女性。
ja: 彼女はサーカスの騎手と訓練し、輪を飛び越え、クロスカントリーで疾走し、しばしば大胆さで称賛される唯一の女性でした。
local: She trains with circus riders, leaps through hoops, gallops cross country, often as the only woman admired for her boldness.
ja_pron: Kanojo wa sākasu no kishu to kunren shi, wa o tobikoe, kurosu kantorī de shissō shi, shibashiba daitan-sa de shōsan sareru yuiitsu no josei deshita.
native: She trains with circus riders, leaps through hoops, gallops cross country, often as the only woman admired for her boldness.

en: Riding becomes her elixir of life and her weapon against the confines of the court.
zh: 騎馬成為她的生命靈藥，也是她對抗宮廷束縛的武器。
ja: 乗馬は彼女の命の霊薬となり、宮廷の束縛に対抗する武器となりました。
local: Riding becomes her elixir of life and her weapon against the confines of the court.
ja_pron: Jōba wa kanojo no inochi no reiyaku to nari, kyūtei no sokubaku ni taikō suru buki to narimashita.
native: Riding becomes her elixir of life and her weapon against the confines of the court.

en: After her triumph, Elizabeth was restless.
zh: 勝利之後，伊麗莎白感到不安。
ja: 勝利の後、エリザベートは落ち着きませんでした。
local: After her triumph, Elizabeth was restless.
ja_pron: Shōri no ato, Erizabēto wa ochitsukimasen deshita.
native: After her triumph, Elizabeth was restless.

en: Hungary was her paradise, but she wanted more.
zh: 匈牙利是她的天堂，但她想要更多。
ja: ハンガリーは彼女の楽園でしたが、彼女はもっと望んでいました。
local: Hungary was her paradise, but she wanted more.
ja_pron: Hangarī wa kanojo no rakuen deshita ga, kanojo wa motto nozonde imashita.
native: Hungary was her paradise, but she wanted more.

en: New challenges, new escapes.
zh: 新的挑戰，新的逃避。
ja: 新たな挑戦、新たな逃避。
local: New challenges, new escapes.
ja_pron: Aratana chōsen, aratana tōhi.
native: New challenges, new escapes.

en: The heart of equestrian art was in England, Fox Hunt's risky bold, a sport for the elite.
zh: 馬術藝術的核心在英格蘭，狐狸狩獵大膽而冒險，是精英的運動。
ja: 馬術芸術の中心はイングランドにあり、フォックスハントは大胆で危険な、エリートのスポーツでした。
local: The heart of equestrian art was in England, Fox Hunt's risky bold, a sport for the elite.
ja_pron: Bajutsu geijutsu no chūshin wa Ingurando ni ari, Fokkusu Hanto wa daitan de kiken na, erīto no supōtsu deshita.
native: The heart of equestrian art was in England, Fox Hunt's risky bold, a sport for the elite.

en: In 1874, under the pretext that the six-year-old Valerie needed C.A.,
zh: 1874年，以六歲的瓦萊麗需要C.A.為藉口，
ja: 1874年、6歳のヴァレリーがC.A.を必要としているという口実で、
local: In 1874, under the pretext that the six-year-old Valerie needed C.A.,
ja_pron: 1874-nen, 6-sai no Varerī ga C.A. o hitsuyō to shite iru to iu kōjitsu de,
native: In 1874, under the pretext that the six-year-old Valerie needed C.A.,

en: the 37-year-old Empress traveled to England and Ireland.
zh: 這位37歲的皇后前往英格蘭和愛爾蘭。
ja: 37歳の皇后はイングランドとアイルランドを訪れました。
local: the 37-year-old Empress traveled to England and Ireland.
native: the 37-year-old Empress traveled to England and Ireland.

en: The court is appalled. She snubs Queen Victoria, yet in London, the crowds cheer her enthusiastically.
zh: 宮廷感到震驚。她冷落維多利亞女王，但在倫敦，人群熱烈歡呼她。
ja: 宮廷は驚愕しました。彼女はヴィクトリア女王を無視しますが、ロンドンでは群衆が熱狂的に彼女を称えます。
local: The court is appalled. She snubs Queen Victoria, yet in London, the crowds cheer her enthusiastically.
native: The court is appalled. She snubs Queen Victoria, yet in London, the crowds cheer her enthusiastically.

en: At Earl Spencer's, she meets Bay Middleton, England's most famous rider.
zh: 在厄爾·斯賓塞家，她遇見了英格蘭最著名的騎手貝·米德爾頓。
ja: アール・スペンサーの家で、彼女はイングランドで最も有名な騎手ベイ・ミドルトンに出会います。
local: At Earl Spencer's, she meets Bay Middleton, England's most famous rider.
native: At Earl Spencer's, she meets Bay Middleton, England's most famous rider.

en: Strict, relentless, precisely what she seeks.
zh: 嚴格、無情，正是她所尋求的。
ja: 厳格で容赦ない、それがまさに彼女が求めているものでした。
local: Strict, relentless, precisely what she seeks.
native: Strict, relentless, precisely what she seeks.

en: Under his training, she excels.
zh: 在他的訓練下，她表現出色。
ja: 彼の指導のもと、彼女は優れた成果を上げます。
local: Under his training, she excels.
native: Under his training, she excels.

en: She races across fields through hedges, over walls, keeping pace with the leading men.
zh: 她穿越田野、穿過樹籬、越過牆壁，與領先的男子保持同速。
ja: 彼女は野原を駆け抜け、生け垣や壁を越え、先頭の男性たちと同じペースで走ります。
local: She races across fields through hedges, over walls, keeping pace with the leading men.
native: She races across fields through hedges, over walls, keeping pace with the leading men.

en: Only a few reach the goal. Elizabeth is among them.
zh: 只有少數人達到終點，伊莉莎白就在其中。
ja: ゴールにたどり着くのはわずか数人で、エリザベートもその一人です。
local: Only a few reach the goal. Elizabeth is among them.
native: Only a few reach the goal. Elizabeth is among them.

en: Soon it is said that no woman in Europe rides better.
zh: 很快人們說歐洲沒有女人騎得比她更好。
ja: やがて、ヨーロッパで彼女より上手に乗る女性はいないと言われるようになります。
local: Soon it is said that no woman in Europe rides better.
native: Soon it is said that no woman in Europe rides better.

en: But even here, rumours follow, conveyed by more than one teacher.
zh: 但即使在這裡，謠言也隨之而來，由不止一位老師傳出。
ja: しかしここでも、複数の教師から伝えられる噂がついて回ります。
local: But even here, rumours follow, conveyed by more than one teacher.
native: But even here, rumours follow, conveyed by more than one teacher.

en: Most historians believe not, but Elizabeth is enthusiastic.
zh: 大多數歷史學家不相信，但伊莉莎白很熱衷。
ja: 多くの歴史家はそうは思いませんが、エリザベートは熱心です。
local: Most historians believe not, but Elizabeth is enthusiastic.
native: Most historians believe not, but Elizabeth is enthusiastic.

en: England could have helped me in India.
zh: 英格蘭本可以在印度幫助我。
ja: イングランドはインドで私を助けることができたはずです。
local: England could have helped me in India.
native: England could have helped me in India.

en: It's where the mine appeared of her coffin.
zh: 那裡出現了她棺材的礦坑。
ja: そこは彼女の棺の鉱山が現れた場所です。
local: It's where the mine appeared of her coffin.
native: It's where the mine appeared of her coffin.

en: In 1876, when Middleton married, the 39-year-old Empress felt hurt and deeply disappointed.
zh: 1876年，當米德爾頓結婚時，39歲的皇后感到受傷和深深失望。
ja: 1876年、ミドルトンが結婚したとき、39歳の皇后は傷つき、深く失望しました。
local: In 1876, when Middleton married, the 39-year-old Empress felt hurt and deeply disappointed.
native: In 1876, when Middleton married, the 39-year-old Empress felt hurt and deeply disappointed.

en: She completely cuts off all contact, sells her horses and never sets foot in England again.
zh: 她完全斷絕所有聯繫，賣掉馬匹，再也不踏足英格蘭。
ja: 彼女は完全に連絡を絶ち、馬を売り、二度とイングランドに足を踏み入れませんでした。
local: She completely cuts off all contact, sells her horses and never sets foot in England again.
native: She completely cuts off all contact, sells her horses and never sets foot in England again.

en: For Sissy, England stays a short-lived triumph, a chapter of glory and also of pain.
zh: 對於西西來說，英格蘭是一段短暫的勝利，一章榮耀也帶來痛苦。
ja: シシィにとって、イングランドは短命の勝利であり、栄光と痛みの章でした。
local: For Sissy, England stays a short-lived triumph, a chapter of glory and also of pain.
native: For Sissy, England stays a short-lived triumph, a chapter of glory and also of pain.

en: Once again, she found something wonderful and lost it again.
zh: 她再次找到美好的事物，卻又失去它。
ja: 彼女は再び素晴らしいものを見つけましたが、また失ってしまいました。
local: Once again, she found something wonderful and lost it again.
native: Once again, she found something wonderful and lost it again.

en: In this time of disappointment, Elizabeth finds comfort in someone who understands her.
zh: 在這失望的時刻，伊莉莎白在一位理解她的人身上找到安慰。
ja: 失望の時期に、エリザベートは自分を理解してくれる人に慰めを見出します。
local: In this time of disappointment, Elizabeth finds comfort in someone who understands her.
native: In this time of disappointment, Elizabeth finds comfort in someone who understands her.

en: While the world celebrates her as a Queen and a Questrian, she seeks something else.
zh: 當世界慶祝她是女王和騎士時，她尋找著別的東西。
ja: 世界が彼女を女王であり騎手として称賛する一方で、彼女は別の何かを求めています。
local: While the world celebrates her as a Queen and a Questrian, she seeks something else.
native: While the world celebrates her as a Queen and a Questrian, she seeks something else.

en: And she ultimately finds it with her cousin, Ludwig II of Bavaria.
zh: 最終她在她的表親，巴伐利亞的路德維希二世身上找到了它。
ja: そして最終的に彼女は、いとこのバイエルンのルートヴィヒ2世のもとでそれを見つけます。
local: And she ultimately finds it with her cousin, Ludwig II of Bavaria.
native: And she ultimately finds it with her cousin, Ludwig II of Bavaria.

en: Even as a child, Ludwig had admired her, now in the late.
zh: 即使是孩童時期，路德維希就已經敬佩她，現在到了晚年。
ja: 子供の頃からルートヴィヒは彼女を敬愛しており、今は晩年に差し掛かっています。
local: Even as a child, Ludwig had admired her, now in the late.
native: Even as a child, Ludwig had admired her, now in the late.

en: 18th century, they meet regularly at Lake Stonberg.
zh: 18世紀末，他們定期在斯通伯格湖會面。
ja: 18世紀後半、彼らは定期的にシュトーンベルク湖で会っていました。
local: 18th century, they meet regularly at Lake Stonberg.
native: 18th century, they meet regularly at Lake Stonberg.

en: I'm Purnish owner Reich.
zh: 我是普尼什擁有者賴希。
ja: 私はプルニッシュ所有者のライヒです。
local: I'm Purnish owner Reich.
native: I'm Purnish owner Reich.

en: I'm Manchmet Reumann.
zh: 我是曼奇梅特·羅曼。
ja: 私はマンシュメット・ロイマンです。
local: I'm Manchmet Reumann.
native: I'm Manchmet Reumann.

en: Elizabeth is around 40, Ludwig in his early 30s.
zh: 伊莉莎白約40歲，路德維希約30出頭。
ja: エリザベートは約40歳、ルートヴィヒは30代前半です。
local: Elizabeth is around 40, Ludwig in his early 30s.
native: Elizabeth is around 40, Ludwig in his early 30s.

en: Both have experienced their dreams and disappointments.
zh: 兩人都經歷過夢想與失望。
ja: 二人とも夢と失望を経験しています。
local: Both have experienced their dreams and disappointments.
native: Both have experienced their dreams and disappointments.

en: They take a walk, exchange poems, talk about music, about Wagner, about the burden of the crown.
zh: 他們散步、交換詩歌，談論音樂、瓦格納以及王冠的重擔。
ja: 彼らは散歩をし、詩を交換し、音楽やワーグナー、王冠の重荷について語り合います。
local: They take a walk, exchange poems, talk about music, about Wagner, about the burden of the crown.
native: They take a walk, exchange poems, talk about music, about Wagner, about the burden of the crown.

en: It's not romantic love, but a soul friendship.
zh: 這不是浪漫的愛情，而是靈魂的友誼。
ja: それは恋愛ではなく、魂の友情です。
local: It's not romantic love, but a soul friendship.
native: It's not romantic love, but a soul friendship.

en: Two individuals who feel trapped inside a gilded cage.
zh: 兩個感覺被困在金籠子裡的人。
ja: 金の鳥かごに閉じ込められたと感じる二人の個人です。
local: Two individuals who feel trapped inside a gilded cage.
native: Two individuals who feel trapped inside a gilded cage.

en: He escapes into fairy tale castles and operas, she, into travels and horses,
zh: 他逃入童話城堡和歌劇，她則投入旅行和馬匹，
ja: 彼はおとぎ話の城やオペラに逃げ込み、彼女は旅と馬に没頭します。
local: He escapes into fairy tale castles and operas, she, into travels and horses,
native: He escapes into fairy tale castles and operas, she, into travels and horses,

en: and both know deep down that the other understands what no one else truly grasps.
zh: 兩人都深知對方理解著其他人無法真正理解的事。
ja: そして二人とも、他の誰も本当に理解していないことをお互いが理解していることを心の奥底で知っています。
local: and both know deep down that the other understands what no one else truly grasps.
native: and both know deep down that the other understands what no one else truly grasps.

en: For Elizabeth, Ludwig is a mirror.
zh: 對伊莉莎白來說，路德維希是一面鏡子。
ja: エリザベートにとって、ルートヴィヒは鏡のような存在です。
local: For Elizabeth, Ludwig is a mirror.
native: For Elizabeth, Ludwig is a mirror.

en: In him, she sees how a sensitive person can crumble under the weight of the crown.
zh: 她從他身上看到敏感的人如何在王冠的重擔下崩潰。
ja: 彼の中に、繊細な人が王冠の重圧で崩れ落ちる様子を見ています。
local: In him, she sees how a sensitive person can crumble under the weight of the crown.
native: In him, she sees how a sensitive person can crumble under the weight of the crown.

en: And perhaps she senses that she, too, is on this path.
zh: 也許她感覺到自己也走在這條路上。
ja: そしておそらく、彼女もまたその道を歩んでいることを感じています。
local: And perhaps she senses that she, too, is on this path.
native: And perhaps she senses that she, too, is on this path.

en: Only with Marie Valerie does Elizabeth experience what she had always longed for.
zh: 只有和瑪麗·瓦萊麗在一起，伊莉莎白才體驗到她一直渴望的東西。
ja: エリザベートはマリー・ヴァレリーとだけ、ずっと望んでいたものを経験します。
local: Only with Marie Valerie does Elizabeth experience what she had always longed for.
native: Only with Marie Valerie does Elizabeth experience what she had always longed for.

en: Closeness, love, trust.
zh: 親密、愛、信任。
ja: 親密さ、愛、信頼です。
local: Closeness, love, trust.
native: Closeness, love, trust.

en: She spends hours with her.
zh: 她與她共度數小時。
ja: 彼女は彼女と何時間も過ごします。
local: She spends hours with her.
native: She spends hours with her.

en: They read, they play, they tell stories.
zh: 她們閱讀、玩耍、講故事。
ja: 彼女たちは読書をし、遊び、物語を語ります。
local: They read, they play, they tell stories.
native: They read, they play, they tell stories.

en: For the first time, she has control over education, clothing, teachers, and she thrives in it.
zh: 她首次掌控教育、服裝、老師，並在其中茁壯成長。
ja: 初めて彼女は教育、服装、教師を管理し、それに満足しています。
local: For the first time, she has control over education, clothing, teachers, and she thrives in it.
native: For the first time, she has control over education, clothing, teachers, and she thrives in it.

en: But this close bond also has a price.
zh: 但這種親密的關係也有代價。
ja: しかし、この親密な絆には代償もあります。
local: But this close bond also has a price.
native: But this close bond also has a price.

en: Marie Valerie grows up in her mother's shadow,
zh: 瑪麗·瓦萊麗在母親的陰影中長大，
ja: マリー・ヴァレリーは母親の影の中で育ちます。
local: Marie Valerie grows up in her mother's shadow,
native: Marie Valerie grows up in her mother's shadow,

en: over-protected, almost like a prisoner of her love.
zh: 被過度保護，幾乎像是她愛的囚徒。
ja: 過保護に育てられ、ほとんど母の愛の囚人のようです。
local: over-protected, almost like a prisoner of her love.
native: over-protected, almost like a prisoner of her love.

en: Even as an adult, she would write about herself.
zh: 即使成年後，她也會寫下自己的心情。
ja: 大人になっても、彼女は自分自身について書いています。
local: Even as an adult, she would write about herself.
native: Even as an adult, she would write about herself.

en: I never belonged to myself.
zh: 我從未屬於自己。
ja: 私は決して自分自身のものではありませんでした。
local: I never belonged to myself.
native: I never belonged to myself.

en: I was always just my mother's child.
zh: 我一直只是我母親的孩子。
ja: 私はいつも母の子供でした。
local: I was always just my mother's child.
native: I was always just my mother's child.

en: So Valerie becomes her support, but also a burden.
zh: 所以瓦萊麗成為她的支柱，但同時也是負擔。
ja: だからヴァレリーは彼女の支えになりますが、同時に負担でもあります。
local: So Valerie becomes her support, but also a burden.
native: So Valerie becomes her support, but also a burden.

en: What Elizabeth gains with her, she loses with Jisela and Rudolph.
zh: 伊莉莎白與瓦萊麗獲得的，她在吉塞拉和魯道夫那裡失去。
ja: エリザベートがヴァレリーと得るものは、ジゼラとルドルフとは失われます。
local: What Elizabeth gains with her, she loses with Jisela and Rudolph.
native: What Elizabeth gains with her, she loses with Jisela and Rudolph.

en: The alienation grows.
zh: 疏離感加深。
ja: 疎外感が増していきます。
local: The alienation grows.
native: The alienation grows.

en: And friends, Joseph, he loves Elizabeth until the end, but he doesn't understand her.
zh: 而朋友約瑟夫，他愛著伊莉莎白直到最後，但他不理解她。
ja: そして友人のヨーゼフは、最後までエリザベートを愛していますが、彼女を理解していません。
local: And friends, Joseph, he loves Elizabeth until the end, but he doesn't understand her.
native: And friends, Joseph, he loves Elizabeth until the end, but he doesn't understand her.

en: He is a man of duty, a life in documents, audiences, armies.
zh: 他是個責任感強的人，生活在文件、聽證會和軍隊中。
ja: 彼は義務の人であり、書類、謁見、軍隊の生活を送っています。
local: He is a man of duty, a life in documents, audiences, armies.
native: He is a man of duty, a life in documents, audiences, armies.

en: She, on the other hand, is a woman of longing, freedom, escape.
zh: 而她則是渴望、自由、逃避的女人。
ja: 一方で彼女は、憧れ、自由、逃避の女性です。
local: She, on the other hand, is a woman of longing, freedom, escape.
native: She, on the other hand, is a woman of longing, freedom, escape.

en: Elizabeth, blab in vain.
zh: 伊莉莎白，徒勞地嘮叨。
ja: エリザベートは無駄におしゃべりします。
local: Elizabeth, blab in vain.
native: Elizabeth, blab in vain.

en: He can't eat.
zh: 他吃不下。
ja: 彼は食べられません。
local: He can't eat.
native: He can't eat.

en: He keeps asking her to stay in Vienna.
zh: 他一直要求她留在維也納。
ja: 彼は彼女にウィーンに留まるように頼み続けます。
local: He keeps asking her to stay in Vienna.
native: He keeps asking her to stay in Vienna.

en: She keeps leaving.
zh: 她一直離開。
ja: 彼女は何度も去っていきます。
local: She keeps leaving.
native: She keeps leaving.

en: Their marriage soon becomes just letters, brief meetings, formal events.
zh: 他們的婚姻很快變成了書信、短暫的會面和正式場合。
ja: 彼らの結婚生活はすぐに手紙、短い会合、公式の行事だけになります。
local: Their marriage soon becomes just letters, brief meetings, formal events.
native: Their marriage soon becomes just letters, brief meetings, formal events.

en: What started as a love story has turned into mere coexistence.
zh: 起初的愛情故事已變成了單純的共存。
ja: 愛の物語として始まったものが、単なる共存に変わってしまいました。
local: What started as a love story has turned into mere coexistence.
native: What started as a love story has turned into mere coexistence.

en: For friends, Joseph, the Hofburg is an office, but for Elizabeth, it feels like a prison.
zh: 對朋友約瑟夫來說，霍夫堡是辦公室，但對伊莉莎白來說，感覺像監獄。
ja: 友人ヨーゼフにとってホーフブルクはオフィスですが、エリザベートにとっては監獄のように感じられます。
local: For friends, Joseph, the Hofburg is an office, but for Elizabeth, it feels like a prison.
native: For friends, Joseph, the Hofburg is an office, but for Elizabeth, it feels like a prison.

en: So Elizabeth lives in two worlds, celebrated as the Queen of Hungary, admired as a rider in England,
zh: 因此伊莉莎白生活在兩個世界中，被讚譽為匈牙利女王，在英格蘭被敬佩為騎手，
ja: だからエリザベートは二つの世界に生きています。ハンガリーの女王として称えられ、イングランドでは騎手として称賛されています。
local: So Elizabeth lives in two worlds, celebrated as the Queen of Hungary, admired as a rider in England,
native: So Elizabeth lives in two worlds, celebrated as the Queen of Hungary, admired as a rider in England,

en: understood as Ludwig's soul mate.
zh: 被理解為路德維希的靈魂伴侶。
ja: ルートヴィヒの魂の伴侶として理解されています。
local: understood as Ludwig's soul mate.
native: understood as Ludwig's soul mate.

en: As a mother close to Valerie yet distant from her other children, and as a woman increasingly distant from her emperor.
zh: 作為一位與瓦萊麗親近但與其他孩子疏遠的母親，以及一位與皇帝日益疏遠的女性。
ja: ヴァレリーには近い母親でありながら、他の子供たちとは距離があり、皇帝からもますます遠ざかる女性として。
local: As a mother close to Valerie yet distant from her other children, and as a woman increasingly distant from her emperor.
native: As a mother close to Valerie yet distant from her other children, and as a woman increasingly distant from her emperor.

en: The shadows grow longer.
zh: 陰影越來越長。
ja: 影が長くなっていきます。
local: The shadows grow longer.
native: The shadows grow longer.

en: She's passed 40, Rudolph now 20 carries deep scars.
zh: 她已過40歲，魯道夫現在20歲，帶著深刻的傷痕。
ja: 彼女は40歳を過ぎ、ルドルフは今20歳で深い傷を負っています。
local: She's passed 40, Rudolph now 20 carries deep scars.
native: She's passed 40, Rudolph now 20 carries deep scars.

en: She's Ella stays cool and distant, finding her anchor solely in Marie Valerie.
zh: 她保持冷靜和疏離，唯一的依靠是瑪麗·瓦萊麗。
ja: 彼女は冷静で距離を置き、マリー・ヴァレリーだけを支えにしています。
local: She's Ella stays cool and distant, finding her anchor solely in Marie Valerie.
native: She's Ella stays cool and distant, finding her anchor solely in Marie Valerie.

en: Elizabeth seems to have triumphed, yet she grows ever more restless, constantly fleeing from country to country,
zh: 伊莉莎白似乎已經取得勝利，但她越來越不安，持續從一國逃到另一國，
ja: エリザベートは勝利を収めたように見えますが、ますます落ち着かず、国から国へと逃げ続けています。
local: Elizabeth seems to have triumphed, yet she grows ever more restless, constantly fleeing from country to country,
native: Elizabeth seems to have triumphed, yet she grows ever more restless, constantly fleeing from country to country,

en: castle to castle, as if trying to escape her own soul.
zh: 從城堡到城堡，彷彿試圖逃離自己的靈魂。
ja: 城から城へと、まるで自分の魂から逃げようとしているかのようです。
local: castle to castle, as if trying to escape her own soul.
native: castle to castle, as if trying to escape her own soul.

en: The triumphs cannot fill the inner void, where this flight is heading.
zh: 這些勝利無法填補內心的空虛，而這逃亡正朝向那裡。
ja: 勝利は内なる空虚を満たすことができず、この逃避はその空虚へと向かっています。
local: The triumphs cannot fill the inner void, where this flight is heading.
native: The triumphs cannot fill the inner void, where this flight is heading.

en: That's exactly what you'll discover in part three.
zh: 這正是你們將在第三部分發現的。
ja: それがまさにパート3であなたが発見することです。
local: That's exactly what you'll discover in part three.
native: That's exactly what you'll discover in part three.
